scripts.install:backend: python -m venv backend\.venv && .\backend\.venv\bin\python.exe -m pip install -r backend\requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.seed:backend: python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && python backend/scripts/seed_test_data.py
scripts.test:backend:unit: set PYTHONPATH=backend&& set COVERAGE_CORE=pytrace&& backend\.venv\bin\pytest.exe backend\app\tests\test_nutrition_unit.py --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:backend:unit
